final_message:
I fixed the following issues in the source code:

1. In export.py, I updated to_csv_row to properly escape names containing commas or double quotes by wrapping them in double quotes and doubling internal quotes, as per RFC 4180.

2. In pricing.py, I enhanced parse_price to remove commas from the price string and handle accounting style negative prices with parentheses. I also fixed apply_discount to use the "round half up" rounding mode as specified.

3. In report.py, I corrected low_stock to include only items with quantity strictly below the threshold and to return the names sorted alphabetically ignoring case.

After these fixes, all tests passed successfully when running with the correct PYTHONPATH. The code now fully meets the docstring specifications and passes the test suite.
